WITH color_totals AS (
  SELECT p.product_color, SUM(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS quantity
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
  JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_color
),
stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(quantity) AS avg_quantity, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity
  FROM color_totals
)
SELECT AVG(c.quantity) AS average_quantity,
       AVG(CAST(c.quantity AS REAL) / s.total_quantity) AS average_share,
       AVG(c.quantity - s.avg_quantity) AS average_excess
FROM color_totals AS c
CROSS JOIN stats AS s
WHERE c.quantity > s.avg_quantity
